summary.title: BODØ BOLIG OG NÆRINGSEIENDOM AS

narrative.text: BODØ BOLIG OG NÆRINGSEIENDOM AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom", registered 2000-12-07.
Registered activity: Utleie av fast eiendom. Deltakelse i andre selskaper og hva som naturlig hører inn under dette.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 686,520 and an annual result of NOK 285,785.
Registered leadership: Ole Widar Toftesund (Styrets leder).
Head office in Bodø, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
